meta.generatedFrom: Copycat tab feeds in app/lib/copycat, cleaned with the same helpers the UI uses (cleanCopycatDisplayText, isCopycatPromoNoiseSlide, normalizeCopycatPosts).
meta.categoryAndLevel: Copycat posts have no category or level. Those fields exist only on the separate Spill It MongoDB levels collection used by /api/levels, which the Copycat tab does not read.

template17.backgroundToday: static file /image-templates/template-17-cover.jpg for every slide. Template 17 does not call /api/openai/cover-image or /api/gemini/generate-image.
template17.coverCrop: object-cover, anchored at 22% from the top (drawCoverImage y = (height - drawnHeight) * 0.22)

imagePrompt.whyNotExact: buildCoverImagePromptText (app/lib/cover-image-openai.ts) is the only step that turns card text into an image prompt. It calls the OpenAI Responses API with a stored prompt id and variables: { questiontext }. The stored prompt body is not in the repo, and OPENAI_API_KEY is not available in this environment, so the model output cannot be reproduced. Template 17 never calls that function.
imagePrompt.whatTheStoredPromptReceives: One string, questiontext. In the automate flow that string is the set title (OpenAI /api/openai/title output, else the category name), not each question. pickCoverPromptId uses the requested id when it is one of the three above, otherwise a random one of the three.
imagePrompt.promptBuilderInputInThisFile: The cleaned question text only. Answer options are kept on the question record and are not interpolated, because template 17 paints slide text itself and the photo is only a background.
imagePrompt.equivalentPromptTemplate: Photorealistic vertical photograph, aspect ratio 3:4, for a full-bleed card background. Do not render any words, letters, numbers, captions, logos, or watermarks. The scene should visually suggest this couples question, but the question must not appear as text: "{question}" Keep the subject and the action in the upper two-thirds of the frame. Leave the lower third simple and uncluttered, because a black gradient and white title text are composited over it later. Candid natural light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric, slight grain, unposed documentary photograph. No illustration, no collage, no studio backdrop, no extra graphics.

imageRequestIfWiredLikeCoverImage.promptTabRoute: POST /api/gemini/generate-image sends the prompt string unchanged (OpenAI first, then Gemini, then Vertex). It is not called by template 17.
